essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.source: When I first encountered the concept of frequency in harmonic analysis, I had only a rough understanding of it.
essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.text: 最初接触调和分析中的频率概念时，我对它只有一个粗浅的理解。

essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.source: It wasn't until I studied Littlewood–Paley theory that I began to appreciate the geometric structure underlying the notion of frequency. Even then, I hadn't really thought deeply about what frequency meant from a geometric perspective.
essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.text: 直到学习 Littlewood–Paley 理论，我才开始体会到频率这一概念背后的几何结构。即便如此，那时我也没有真正深入思考过：从几何的角度看，频率究竟意味着什么。

essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.source: Recently, I've been studying some of Seeger's work on singular integrals. Certain techniques used in his proofs have pushed me to revisit these fundamental ideas and think more carefully about the geometry of frequency.
essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.text: 最近，我在学习 Seeger 关于奇异积分的一些工作。他的证明中用到的某些技巧，促使我重新审视这些基本想法，更仔细地思考频率的几何。

essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.source: In fact, it is due to the need for my recent research that I've begun to explore these geometric ideas in greater depth.
essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.text: 事实上，正是出于近期研究的需要，我才开始更深入地探索这些几何想法。

essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.source: The reason I chose the word "basic" in the title of my article is that the ideas themselves are simple, yet profound.
essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.text: 我在文章标题中选用“基本”这个词，是因为这些想法本身简单，却又深刻。

essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.source: I'm planning a series of about three articles, through which I'll gradually build up from these fundamental ideas to Seeger's work on singular integrals.
essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.text: 我计划写一个大约三篇文章的系列，从这些基本想法出发，逐步讲到 Seeger 关于奇异积分的工作。

essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.source: Although the ideas can be quite deep, I'll do my best to explain them in a clear, intuitive, and accessible way, so that even readers without a background in mathematics can follow along.
essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.text: 尽管这些想法可能相当深刻，我还是会尽量把它们讲得清楚、直观、容易理解，让没有数学背景的读者也能跟上。

essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.source: So, if you're not a mathematics major but still have an interest in the subject, don't worry! I'll try to make these ideas approachable without requiring much advanced mathematical knowledge. Just bring your curiosity and enjoy the journey!
essays/fourier-frequency-geometry-1.qmd:.text: 所以，如果你不是数学专业，但对数学仍有兴趣，也不用担心！我会尽量让这些想法容易亲近，不需要太多高深的数学知识。带上你的好奇心，享受这段探索就好！

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::met.source: Finding My Way Back to Mathematics
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::met.text: 重新找回做数学的初心

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::met.source: On AI, the joy of doing mathematics, and finding a way to hold on to both a vocation and an inner life.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::met.text: 关于 AI、做数学的快乐，以及如何兼顾职业与精神生活的思考。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: I remember when I first chose to do mathematical research. I thought it would be a good life to do work that might not be all that important, but that I could feel satisfied with. To devote my career to mathematics.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 想起当年一开始选择做数学科研的那会，就觉得以后如果做些可能没那么重要但是让自己满意的工作，也很不错。把生涯奉献给数学。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: For a while around the middle of this year, I started asking AI to help me work through a problem that had little to do with my own research.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 今年年中有段时间，开始让AI帮我推导一个与自己研究不怎么沾边的问题。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: AI was so powerful. Gradually, I noticed that my attitude toward mathematics was changing. Papers I had once seen as works of art began to look like industrial products, things that could be manufactured in bulk.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: ai的能力太强大了。慢慢地我发现，在那段时间，我看待数学的态度发生了改变。以前觉得是艺术品的论文，开始觉得像工业品一样，是可以生产批发的。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: During that period, I had more or less lost control over what AI was generating. I wasn't looking closely at what results it had produced or what proofs it had completed. It worked too fast. My understanding of what it was doing went no further than the log it submitted each time—which arguments it had completed in that round, and what remained unresolved. Beyond that, I knew nothing about its work. I had no way to stay in control or judge what it was producing, and I wouldn't post any of it. I think the minimum responsibility of a mathematical researcher should be to stand behind what they produce.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 那段时间我基本对ai生成的内容失去了掌控，我不会去细究它生产了什么样的结果，闭合了什么证明。它做的太快了。我对它在做问题的了解仅仅止步于每次提交的日志报告——本轮闭合了什么推导，还有什么没有解决，除此之外，我对它的工作一无所知。我没有办法掌控和辨别，也不会把它们挂出来。我觉得数学科研者的底线应该是对自己产出的内容负责。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: I wasn't getting much joy out of mathematics then. Every day, I'd excitedly follow which model had just been updated, which model had come out on top on FrontierMath, and then off I'd eagerly go to try it out and see how it performed.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 我那会并没数学中得到多少乐趣，每天很兴奋地去跟进什么什么模型又更新了，什么模型又在FrontierMath上面胜出了，然后屁颠屁颠去试用，看看效果。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: Later, I realized that I no longer loved mathematics the way I used to. I was becoming more and more focused on results. So I made up my mind to change:
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 再后来，我意识到我没有像以前那样热爱数学了，变得越来越结果导向。然后下定决心改变:

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: If I had started learning mathematics in the first place to find joy, why should I let anxiety make me willingly give up this hard-won ability to feel it?
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 如果我本来学数学的意图就是为了收获快乐，为什么要因为焦虑而主动放弃这来之不易的快乐感知呢？

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: I began to rethink my relationship with AI. When reading papers, I stopped asking it to generate companion notes and went back to slowly working through the originals. I also stopped asking AI to solve problems, and instead began exploring research outside my own field that interested me. When I came across something I didn't understand, I still asked AI, but my mindset was different. I wouldn't just ask it to solve the problem for me. Instead, I treated it as a search engine, going back to my caveman ways.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 我开始重新调整自己与ai的身份关系，读论文时不再让ai生成一份辅助资料，对着原文慢慢啃。我也不再让ai去解问题，而是去做一些非我领域的且我感兴趣的研究。遇到不懂的东西，我仍然会问AI，但心态已经不同了，也不会直接让ai解题。而是作为一个搜索引擎，回归原始人状态。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: Slowing down makes the pressure of the times a little less suffocating.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 放慢脚步，会让时代的压迫感没那么令人窒息。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: Whether we like it or not, we have all been forced into an extraordinarily brutal upheaval, unable to see what lies ahead. That includes the figures in mathematics who were once celebrated as the pinnacle of human intelligence. The mathematical beauty and ideals we once held dear have been mercilessly crushed by the steamroller of the times. I can work slowly on mathematics and enjoy the process, but the times will not wait for me.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 不管喜欢与否，我们都被迫卷入了一场极其残酷的动荡，看不清未来，包括数学界那些曾经被诩为最高智慧的人物。心中曾经的数学审美与理想追求，被时代的压路机无情碾过。我可以慢慢做让我享受过程的数学，但是时代不会等我。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: My own advice is not to be too much of a purist, but not to abandon your inner world altogether either. We can work on a problem that interests us, making progress slowly, and we can also use technology to help produce high-quality papers. The two do not conflict. But for now, I still believe that the minimum responsibility of a mathematical researcher should be to stand behind what they produce. Even if most of a piece of work was done by AI, you need to know the details at every point and be able to stand up and vouch for it.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 我个人的建议就是，不要有过高的精神洁癖，但也不要完全放弃精神世界，我们可以做一个自己感兴趣的问题，慢慢推进，也可以使用技术辅助产出高水平的文章，这两者不冲突。但是我当前还是坚持认为数学科研者的底线应该是对自己产出的内容负责，即使你的作品大部分都是ai的工作，你也要知道任何位置的细节是什么样的，能够拍着胸脯担保。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: Separate your interests from your profession. We can be mathematical researchers professionally, while also doing traditional mathematical research as a hobby—taking it one step at a time and enjoying the process. Work is work. Life is life.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 把兴趣和职业分开，我们可以是数学研究人员，但业余兴趣也可以是做传统的数学研究，一步一个脚印享受数学的过程。工作是工作，生活是生活。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: The older generation of mathematicians may be able to weather the impact with the resources, social standing, and titles they have accumulated. What are we supposed to do? Young people who are only just setting out must be at the forefront of productivity.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 老一辈做数学的可能可以靠着积累的资源、社会地位与头衔避过冲击。我们应该怎么办呢？刚刚上路的年轻人必须拥有前列的生产力。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: The truth is, I've felt lost all this time. But I don't want to lose my ideals again. Using AI to do mathematics is where things are headed. Still, setting aside time every day for my own old-school research can be a side pursuit that makes life richer.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 其实我一直很迷茫，但是我不想再一次失去理想。用ai做数学是大势所趋，而每天抽时间做自己的传统派科研，也可以是一个丰富生活的支线。

essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.source: Returning to what drew me here in the first place makes me feel younger. It brings back a childlike sense of wonder, that feeling from my student days when I'd see a beautiful proof, clap in delight, and stay excited all day. That's what I want.
essays/returning-to-mathematics.qmd::bod.text: 回归初心的时候会感觉自己变年轻，会找回童真，会找到学生时代看到一个漂亮证明拍手叫绝兴奋一天的感觉。那是我想要的。

essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::met.source: On the disruption of mathematics by AI, what it may mean for other fields, and why people should stand together.
essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::met.text: 关于 AI 对数学的冲击、其他领域可能面临的变化，以及人们为何应该团结起来的思考。

essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.source: People from outside mathematics come swarming in, throw stones down the well, and walk away laughing.
essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.text: 大量数学之外的人蜂拥而至，向井里投下石子，哄笑着走开。

essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.source: Few people outside mathematics have stopped to consider this: if mathematics, a field at the forefront of this disruption, cannot establish new, workable norms that allow humans and AI to coexist harmoniously, then when other fields face the same disruption and need to build a new order, what useful example will they have to learn from? Chaos will sweep through other industries, again and again.
essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.text: 很少有数学外的人思考过，如果在数学这个受到冲击的先锋领域无法做到建立起新的、合适的行业规范，做到人与AI和谐共生，那么未来其他领域受到冲击的时候，需要建立起新的秩序的时候，又如何拥有一个适合参考的例子来借鉴经验呢？混乱又会一次又一次的席卷其他行业。

essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.source: Every time AI “breaks through” a field, the increase in its power is far more than a matter of 1 + 1 = 2. Coding gives it frightening engineering capabilities, while surpassing humans in mathematics means having formidable abilities in modeling and making breakthroughs on extremely difficult problems. And these two reinforce each other. In other words, with every industry it conquers, AI's capabilities multiply. Different fields strengthen one another, until it becomes too formidable to face and impossible to defeat.
essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.text: 每当AI“攻破”一个领域的时候，它的力量增长远不能1+1=2来测算。代码能力能够让它具有恐怖的工程实现能力，而数学能力超越人类则意味着其拥有极强悍的建模、高难问题突破能力。而这两者是会互相增幅的。也就是说，每当AI攻下一个行业的城池，它的能力会成倍的增加。不同领域之间会互相增益，直到强到不可逼视、不可战胜。

essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.source: When AI moves into other industries in the future, the sheer force of its problem modeling, coding, and breakthroughs in core theory will let it easily overrun other fields of science and engineering. Multimodal breakthroughs are also coming at an increasingly staggering pace, and AI is gaining more and more interfaces with the real world. Perhaps even experimental science will not be a secure moat in the future.
essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.text: 未来AI介入其他行业，暴力的问题建模、编码、核心理论突破，会让其他理工行业轻松失守。多模态的突破速度也越来越夸张，AI得到越来越多真实世界的接口，或许实验科学在以后也未必是稳固的护城河

essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.source: Some people think researching AI itself might offer more security. But today's top models have already begun to iterate on themselves. If, in the future, model training, model releases, and so on no longer need humans to carry them out, will we really need this many people working in AI?
essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.text: 有些人觉得研究ai领域本身可能会比较安全，但是现在顶级模型已经开始自迭代了，当未来模型训练、模型发布等内容本身不需要人类完成的时候，未来真的需要这么多做ai方向的人吗？

essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.source: Embodied intelligence is also beginning to produce results, and AI's ability to act in the real world is growing. Physical labor, hands-on experiments, real-world feedback—all of these will fall too. The threat AI poses to people's ability to survive in most fields is no longer something imagined in science fiction.
essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.text: 包括具身智能的发展也开始陆续取得成果，AI在真实世界的行动能力开始提升。劳动行业、实验操作、真实反馈，这些都会失守。AI威胁人类在大部分领域的生存情况已经不是科幻写作的想象了

essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.source: Since OpenAI published its series of mathematics papers, I've seen a great many posts in the past few days attacking mathematical researchers. Tao has borne the brunt of the criticism, turned into fodder for public opinion.
essays/we-should-stand-together.qmd::bod.text: 自从OpenAI发布一系列数学论文之后，这几天看到非常多攻击数学研究者的帖子，Tao首当其冲受到批评，成为了被舆论消费的对象。
